Game Overview

In Italian Brainrot R.E.P.O Highway Heist, the core idea is straightforward: race through sun-soaked highways in a thrilling escape as R.E.P.O, a rogue robot dodging relentless pursuers. Collect gems while outsmarting chaotic adversaries in a world where chaos and pursuit never cease. Can you secure freedom before becoming scrap in this high-octane chase?
